trigger: 0.9 feature load with thin integration testing; first overnight mass drain gave implausible 2-4h vs prior 6-8 days
method: 3 parallel code audits (drain, 0.9 features, power/USB) + live rig investigation (wakelocks/suspend/pulseaudio/mce)

root_cause_of_scary_result.finding: asteroid-launcher holds an open pulseaudio sink-input, so the primary sink stays RUNNING (not SUSPENDED), keeping the audio hardware clocked and blocking SoC suspend -> 22-36%/h drain with the screen off
root_cause_of_scary_result.evidence: sparrow (H1NZCJ010087020): pactl shows sink.primary RUNNING, sink-input from client asteroid-launcher; mce Display state=off, Blank inhibit=disabled; both watches HAS_SPEAKER=true (no-speaker hypothesis disproven)
root_cause_of_scary_result.note: matches mo's 'pulseaudio wont let it sleep' + Qt6 hypotheses

findings.summary: not_enumerating warning is dead code on the sysfs rig; connect is derived from the same node-existence as present, so guard is always False; docked-but-not-enumerating reports as 'no link / no watch docked / dead cable' (inverse of truth)
findings.fix: populate connect independent of node existence, or key on power and adb None and not present

findings.summary: drained watches need real boot time to re-enumerate (longer than the wait budget); adb server may go stale with no a-d-b self-heal; both seen after the overnight drains
findings.fix: detect/kill-start a wedged adb server; battery-aware re-enumeration budget

findings.summary: power state is a register read (cache TTL 300s) that cannot see a real VBUS cut (A16 buttons); fake-power self-heal rewrites disable and cannot restore a button cut but implies recovery
findings.fix: treat register-power as claim not truth; do not imply un-deliverable recovery

findings.summary: wait_serial_online recovery cycles the port from config (loc,port) fixed at op start; after a physical move it bounces a different watch now on the old seat
findings.fix: cycle the port the serial currently enumerates on

findings.summary: charge and drain are mutually blind; conflict matrix asymmetric and Operation.start never consults active_op_on_slot, so charge.start on a draining slot powers the port ON mid-measurement; RPC path unguarded (CLI path is guarded)
findings.fix: symmetric conflict matrix or route start through active_op_on_slot

findings.summary: 30-min re-power poll applies charger + re-enumerates USB, waking the SoC 48x/day; measures a woken-every-30-min rate, not true standby; compounds the upstream sleep bug
findings.fix: quantify vs 6h poll and vs standby_off_to_on_rate baseline; reduce poll perturbation

findings.summary: _end_port ignores wait_serial_online result, then unconditionally stamps safe_off_ts and cuts VBUS; a watch that never woke is marked 'down' while running on battery invisibly
no minimum duration/sample floor before a rate is saved and seeded fleet-wide; a 1-poll stop saves a noisy 0.5h rate as canonical est_h
findings.fix: refuse/flag rates below min elapsed + sample count

findings.summary: a forced screen (mcetool -D on) is never detected/released by the drain; drain samples get_battery_level only, blind to screen_forced; inspect-then-drain measures a lit panel for days
findings.fix: read battery_and_screen at drain start; refuse or screen(False) first, log it

findings.summary: poll reads the current serial but logs/saves the start serial; a mid-drain remap records watch B under watch A
findings.fix: attribute readings to the serial actually read

findings.summary: initial read holds VBUS on for battery + connman + dconf (longer than a poll), biasing the fixed start_pct anchor up and inflating the whole rate
findings.fix: re-read start_pct after the initial VBUS-off, or subtract the bump

findings.summary: record_audio can orphan gst-launch (host-only timeout, unchecked, no -k fallback, busybox timeout -s INT unverified); orphaned pulsesrc holds CPU and blocks suspend invisibly
findings.fix: timeout -k, verify termination, pkill on cleanup

findings.summary: background warmer does USB/adb reads with no lock against the drain poll (which holds no _adb_lock); overlap can spuriously increment the blind counter toward blind_abort
findings.fix: serialise warmer vs poll bus access

findings.summary: set_datetime is shipped broken: date -s {shlex.quote(when)} — the quote is consumed host-side, adb/ssh re-split, watch runs date -s DATE TIME; wrong time every call on adb and ssh
findings.fix: wrap the whole remote command in one token like set_hands

findings.summary: standby_features reports aod=True on a failed read (ignores rc), mislabelling attribution
weather_sync strips apostrophes from city names (St. John's -> St. Johns)

missing_tests: cross-op conflict contract table {charge,drain,workbench,flash}^2 pairwise refusal (B1)
end-to-end measured-rate on a synthetic known-rate battery model (B2/B7) - highest value
poll-contamination: rate invariant across poll intervals (B2)
safe-off honesty: no 'down' when the watch never woke (B3), planted-bug validated
power-ledger invariant across every drain exit path
